title: Going back in time in dreams with the monks; Harry Heller says time is an illusion

tellings.quote: Which Harry Heller said to me in my book when I was in with the Monotones, and sure enough, he proved it was an illusion cuz I kept going back in time.

plain: In dreams set on a mountain with monks, Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, says he kept going back in time. He tells Michels that a figure he calls Harry Heller told him, in his book, that time is an illusion, and "sure enough, he proved it" through those dreams, with Einstein brought in to support the idea. If true, the past could be visited.
